newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU competition rules to embrace air transport.
newsitem.headline: EU competition rules to embrace air transport.

text.p: The European Commission will move next week to strengthen the EU's competition rules to make them apply to the air transport sector, a Commission spokeswoman said on Friday.

Air transport, which is currently covered by separate EU legislation, is currently exempt from the EU competition rules, which apply in cases of abuse of dominant position and restrictive accords to other industry sectors.

But in view of the increasing number of industry alliances the Commissioner responsible for competition policy Karel Van Miert has moved to increase the EU executive's powers to intervene in deals it sees as anti-competitive.
